result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with high-visibility crosswalk markings but lacks a pedestrian refuge island. The long crossing distance and high-speed design of the road create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: No median or island is present to provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for pedestrian or bicycle infrastructure.

result.summary: The intersection includes basic pedestrian infrastructure such as a marked zebra crosswalk, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the environment lacks physical buffers between the sidewalk and the roadway, and large vehicles can easily obstruct sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large vehicle is positioned such that it blocks the view of the intersection and potential crossing pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, blocking the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk at the corner lacks a physical buffer from moving traffic, such as bollards or planters.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking or standing restrictions near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of a median refuge or visible pedestrian signals create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks visible signals or signage to alert drivers or provide a dedicated phase for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection of the main road and side street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to the crosswalk to increase driver yielding rates.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and basic sidewalk infrastructure, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and a refuge island. The wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic in a mixed-use environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant duration across the wide roadway without a refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Visible Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While traffic lights are present, there are no clearly visible pedestrian-specific signal heads to indicate safe crossing times.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signalized corner on the right

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.
